about: Bug report dumps the dump replay harness replays. Only the link and the SHA-256 are here: a dump holds the reporter's field, so the zip stays where the reporter put it (an issue attachment, or the bug report service for maintainers). See ../README.md.

dumps.title: U-turn in headland ignored
dumps.reported: A U-turn shown on screen was not made at the headland; the reporter asked for a warning when a turn will be skipped.

dumps.title: Dual heading warning at every cold start
dumps.reported: The dual heading warning showed at every power-up, before the receiver had a position, and named $PANDA.

dumps.title: Error in drawing applied area (first dump)
dumps.reported: Worked ground redrawn with only its pass edges, and the painted area wider than the implement (simulator).

dumps.title: Error in drawing applied area (second dump)
dumps.reported: Worked ground redrawn with only its pass edges, and the painted area wider than the implement (simulator).

dumps.title: U-turn at the headland not keeping its distance from the boundary (Send Report)
dumps.reported: On an angled headland a U-turn sat square to the track and touched the turn line at one point; with a 21 m spreader one end came too close to the boundary.

dumps.title: U-turn not following the headland (Keyhole, first dump)
dumps.reported: After #550: on Keyhole a U-turn did not follow the headland when the next pass was outside the field.

dumps.title: U-turn not following the headland (Keyhole, second dump)
dumps.reported: After #550: on Keyhole a U-turn did not follow the headland when the next pass was outside the field.

dumps.title: Out-of-field U-turn alarm repeated many times a second
dumps.reported: With no safe U-turn path the alarm sounded stretched or several times a second until U-turn was switched off.

dumps.title: Raising the U-turn skip rows resets the turn direction
dumps.reported: Raising the skip rows reset a turn chosen to the right back to the left; a turn also started at once after leaving the line slightly in the headland.

dumps.title: U-turn settings changed during a U-turn: wrong pass after it
dumps.reported: Skip rows and the alternating mode changed during a wide U-turn; the turn built for one pass ended on another (pass -13 instead of -6).

dumps.title: Reversing out of a U-turn makes its end the target pass
dumps.reported: Stopped mid-turn and reversed out; on leaving the turn the target pass jumped to where the completed turn would have put the tractor.

dumps.title: Duplicate lines drawn on a driven water pivot
dumps.reported: Driving a water pivot track drew extra paths the tractor never followed (display only, the reporter believes).

dumps.title: U-turn drawn off to the side with an offset tool
dumps.reported: With an offset tool the pass spacing was right but the line that follows the U-turn sat off to the side; the U-turn path showed the source or the end line depending on direction.

dumps.title: Offset tool: U-turn paths beyond the boundary (later build)
dumps.reported: On a later build, with an offset tool, the offset U-turn paths appeared to go outside the boundary.

dumps.title: Section painting ignores the section offset
dumps.reported: With the sprayer offset by 1.5 m the painting appeared ahead of the sections; the map drew a trailed tool with the wrong pivot-distance sign (sections and coverage were right).

dumps.title: Manual section override only after the master section button
dumps.reported: The section buttons appeared only after Auto or Manual was pressed; AgOpenGPS shows them as soon as a job starts.

dumps.title: Create an AB line from the map overview
dumps.reported: The menu to draw an AB line or curve on the field map (AgOpenGPS: the tracks pencil menu) was not found; it is in Field Builder > Tracks.

dumps.title: Headland U-turn going outside the boundary
dumps.reported: A U-turn to an edge pass went outside the boundary (no headland, an AgShare driven boundary with a curved corner): the unchecked fallback semicircle, up to 17 m out.

dumps.title: No valid U-turn: the direction control is not shown
dumps.reported: On an AB curve no headland turn was planned and the direction arrow was not shown to send it the other way (the tractor was stopped inside the headland band).

dumps.title: Boundary AB curve: the straight edge has tails
dumps.reported: A boundary curve from Quick AB loops the long way round; its 200 m straight extensions overlapped along one side and the tractor followed the extension instead of the curve.

dumps.title: Field Builder tracks and Tracks menu disagree
dumps.reported: Tracks unticked in Tracks > Manage AB lines still showed in the Field Builder but could not be made active; tracks could be renamed in one place only.
